instruction: Cinematic still, wide low-angle shot. In a dimly lit hall with wooden floors, three dancers lie on the ground in a synchronized floor routine. In the center, the young man in the white t-shirt and black harness (R3) arches his back in a dramatic backbend. On the left, the blonde man in the black leather jacket (R1) lies on his back with one leg raised. On the right, the man in the black mesh top (R2) lies on his back with legs split. Low-key cool blue and red lighting enhances the dramatic mood.
